name: Banbury Crossroads School (and Banbury Crossroads Academy)

geo.address: 35 Normandy Drive SW, Building B1 #201, Calgary, AB T3E 7K1
geo.coord_source: OpenStreetMap Nominatim geocode of the official address (© OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL), 2026-10-30 — street-level match (Normandy Drive SW)

description: Calgary independent school authority founded 1979 running a self-directed, multi-age, learn-to-mastery programme from Junior Kindergarten to Grade 12 (the School, ratios about 10:1 in Grades 1–6 and 15:1 in Grades 7–12) and a teacher-guided small-group stream for diverse learning needs (the Academy, about 6:1). Also listed by Alberta Education as a supervisor of home education.

attributes.philosophy: Self-Directed Learning: intrinsic motivation, mixed-age classrooms, students set goals and progress at their own pace to mastery; peer mentoring; minimal competition.

legal_status.label: Independent (private) school registered under the Education Act (Alberta); listed by Alberta Education as authority type 'Private School'

attributes.curriculum: Alberta curriculum mastered at individual pace (school statement).
attributes.qualifications_offered: High-school completion; Alberta diploma status not confirmed on pages read.
accreditation: Member, Association of Independent Schools and Colleges in Alberta (AISCA) — per site footer

tuition.notes: Domestic 26/27: School (JK–12) $17,600; Academy (K–12) $19,750; annual registration fee $525. International $25,800. Sibling discount 10% / 15%.

attributes.admission: Tour and application process published on the site.
attributes.class_size: About 10:1 (Gr 1–6) and 15:1 (Gr 7–12) in the School; about 6:1 in the Academy (school statement).
